csv_project_name: DB Service for Shelburne Davis Park Maintenance Building
csv_scope_of_work: The Town of Shelburne is seeking bids to provide design build construction services to construct a new Maintenance garage with a total project cost between $150,000- $205,000. The project is located at Davis Park, 344 Harbor Rd., Shelburne, VT. The existing building consists of an area for the Boy Scouts, and a separate area used as a town maintenance garage, and a small storage area for Parks and Recreational items. The services would include removing the existing Building and Grounds Maintenance shop structure, while leaving the attached Scout barn undisturbed. The Maintenance shop was once part of the Boy Scout warming hut for an ice rink that is no longer on site. The shop is used year-round, but most operations take place from March to October. This project is intended to start and be completed during the off season, from roughly October 15th through April 15th, when not heavily utilized. Access to the Scout barn and playground will need to remain open during construction. The purpose of the project is to construct a new Maintenance Building that closely resembles what the Cemetery did with their building, allowing it to function efficiently for housing various groundskeeping equipment and providing an operations center for staff. This includes an accessible restroom for the public to use while they visit the park. In addition, the existing facility was built around 1983 and is in dire need of upgrades and replacement.
